method: research/harness/index.html served over http://localhost:8752 (python -m http.server via .claude/launch.json); driven with real UI clicks and genuine location.reload() calls, not a simulated restore

cross_runtime_determinism.note: fresh session in the browser produced the same stateId as the Node demo

case_2_continuation_after_reload.note: numbering continued from 3 to 4 rather than restarting at 0

case_3_pending_preview_across_reload.note: the preview.requested event is retained because the log is append-only and the request genuinely occurred; the uncommitted preview itself is correctly not restored

limitations: One browser engine (Chromium). Not tested on Firefox or Safari.
Storage-unavailable paths (private windows, blocked site data, quota exhaustion) are guarded in code but not exercised here.
This is a development harness, not a participant workflow: no consent, no conditions, no pseudonymous IDs.
